findings.title: Configured Google API key is persisted in world-readable Next/Turbopack development cache files
findings.evidence: The exact configured key matched 16 files under .next/dev/cache/turbopack/<VERSION>/*.sst, mode 0644, 239401257 aggregate bytes. Exact matches in artifacts/docs/public/.local-artifacts and client/production bundles were zero.
findings.impact: A local user, backup process, or artifact collector able to read the workspace can recover the paid provider credential.

findings.title: Generator V2 546-outcome registry is not connected to real Student practice
findings.evidence: generateQuestion is used by internal generator proof/review routes. Student curriculum-runtime calls static RPC, while on-demand-practice uses the older on-demand generator. V2 database routes require development, loopback, and proof flags.
findings.impact: Students cannot consume the approved 546-outcome product through normal lessons/practice; usefulness approval was performed on an internal proof surface.

findings.title: Approved representative Generator questions include ambiguous, incomplete, or interaction-mismatched contracts
findings.evidence: Examples include counting sequence with no requested term, rational operation with no operation named, trigonometry with no angle named, unit conversion with no units/direction, fraction request rendered as DECIMAL_INPUT, and integer function value rendered as FRACTION_INPUT.
findings.impact: A student can be unable to infer the intended answer even when the hidden solver has one; feedback and scoring then become misleading.

findings.title: Approved Generator V2 and AI Tutor implementation is absent from repository HEAD
findings.evidence: The worktree has 83 tracked modifications plus untracked Generator V2, Tutor, migration 0042, test, launcher, documentation, and artifact files. git ls-files does not include core new implementation paths.
findings.impact: A clean checkout of the recorded HEAD cannot reproduce the approved milestones, tests, migrations, or operational commands.

findings.title: The full-coverage audit overstates solver independence and semantic diversity evidence
findings.evidence: The full audit invokes generation and verifyQuestionIntegrity, trusts question.validation, and multiple Wave C-F validators call the same solveModel implementation used by generation. Near-duplicate analysis normalizes numeric literals in prompt text rather than comparing mathematical/visual structures.
findings.impact: 32760/32760 proves deterministic self-consistency, not an independent mathematical oracle or product usefulness.

findings.title: Canonical sitewide owner-local browser launcher cannot compile the application
findings.evidence: PLAVE_OWNER_LOCAL_DEMO=true selects tsconfig.owner-local.json, which does not extend the base config and lacks @/* paths. Next reports repeated module-not-found errors. The canonical command times out.
findings.impact: The documented production-like local browser gate and owner-local runtime are not dependable in the current checkout.

findings.title: Fresh AI Tutor browser acceptance fails its primary touch-target requirement
findings.evidence: acceptance:ai-tutor-local stops at DESKTOP_WELCOME_PRIMARY_TOUCH_TARGET_SMALL before completing the browser matrix.
findings.impact: At least one visible primary Tutor control is below the 44x44 product gate, and current browser behavior cannot be certified.

findings.title: Sitewide acceptance uses a stale strict locator that matches two headings
findings.evidence: After diagnostic-only removal of the broken owner-demo config selection, getByRole(heading, name='Lớp Toán V2') resolves both h2 and h3 and aborts the canonical journey.
findings.impact: A valid UI state causes the test harness to fail before it can provide regression evidence.

findings.title: Architecture, artifacts, and executable audit lifecycle states drift from approved milestones
findings.evidence: Active architecture still records 107/546 and M2 in progress; AI Tutor artifacts retain M2 IN_PROGRESS_RESUMED; full browser artifact retains awaiting owner review. The full audit command rewrites ownerDecision to null/awaiting review in its output.
findings.impact: Maintainers cannot safely determine current state, and rerunning an audit can semantically downgrade approval evidence.

findings.title: Most canonical tests are structural and some acceptance evidence is self-attested
findings.evidence: 64 of 96 TypeScript test files read source directly; only one performs fetch and one mentions Playwright. The sitewide script writes a claim that 51 screenshots were opened, although it has no visual-inspection mechanism, and feedback text is deliberately masked in a screenshot.
findings.impact: High PASS counts can coexist with broken launchers, runtime disconnects, and unusable prompts.

findings.title: The product references support without providing a support route or contact surface
findings.evidence: No support/contact page exists in the 55-page route inventory, while error copy tells users to contact PLAVE.
findings.impact: Users who cannot recover their account or invitation have no actionable in-product escalation path.

findings.title: Practice generation has multiple coexisting pipelines and weak onboarding documentation
findings.evidence: Static curriculum-runtime, adaptive, on-demand generation, generated pilot, Generator V1, and Generator V2 coexist with different flags and routes. No repository README or CI workflow exists; several core files exceed 1000 lines and the practice regression file exceeds 13000 lines.
findings.impact: Feature ownership, safe runtime selection, and future changes are error-prone.

findings.title: Lint and Node execution are not warning-free
findings.evidence: Lint reports one unused _args warning; repeated MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warnings occur because package.json has no module type.
findings.impact: Noise reduces the signal of future warnings and contradicts zero-warning status text.

findings.title: The above-fold PLAVE logo emits an LCP loading warning
findings.evidence: Fresh sitewide runtime reports that /brand/plave-logo-header.png should be eagerly loaded.
findings.impact: Potential avoidable local LCP delay; production effect was not measured.

findings.title: The Grade 1 lesson catalog is very dense on narrow mobile
findings.evidence: The reviewed 390px lesson screenshot renders many near-identical status cards in one long page with small secondary copy, although no horizontal overflow was detected.
findings.impact: Scanning and choosing the next lesson may be tiring for young learners.

recommendedRemediationOrder: Contain the exposed Google credential in development cache, purge affected cache copies, and rotate the credential through the Owner-controlled process.
Decide whether Milestone 2 must be reopened; connect Generator V2 to the real Student runtime only after product-invalid contracts are fixed.
Introduce genuinely independent capability-family oracles and semantic/visual diversity validation.
Make the approved implementation reproducible from version-controlled source and restore canonical local browser launchers.
Fix Tutor touch targets, stale browser locators, active status drift, and audit commands that overwrite approval state.
Add CI, a maintainer README, support UX, and reduce practice-pipeline complexity.
